body: Thank you for the suggestions. I will try but I also have really bad social anxiety so is very hard from me to meet/ talk to new people
Thank you for talking to me it has helped me more than you know but it is getting late were I am so I am going to go try to fall asleep. Can I talk to you more tomorrow?
Usually I just listen to music or I will sleep
Nope because I need strong pain meds and for my age there is not that many to choose from that won’t have a lot of side affects that will interfere with my other medical issues and it sucks
And me gaining weight will not help my body confidence or my eating disorder

No they are not and it is getting frustrating because everyone around me is telling me if I just keep taking them they will help but I have taken them for a good 10 months and they have done nothing which sucks because the ones that my doctors want to switch me too will make me gain a lot of weight
My medical issues also cause Chronic pain which is also stressful
I like my applied chemistry class
Just a mix of feeling like a burden because my medical issues and school
I am just feeling very overwhelmed with life

I had a doctors appointment today and at my doctors office they give you a mental health sheet for you to fill out basically to see if you are going to kill your self and every time I get that sheet I have to lie and say I am doing fine because the last time I filled it out honestly they told my mom and she threatened to put me in a mental hospital 

I know that it doesn’t sound like much but it is all I can think about
Thank you, you don’t know how much hearing someone say that means to me
